verdict.rationale: Bulk operations across many items are a fair axis for a game editor, but the evidence never documents a bulk or batch capability, such as multi-object editing or batch asset operations. What it does show are developer building blocks: scripting APIs, the Asset Database, command-line batch automation, and CLI/MCP control of the Editor. Agents could use these to build bulk workflows, but building blocks earn no credit here. Build Automation's simultaneous multi-platform builds are an adjacent build feature, not bulk operations on items.
